prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless opaque diffuse water material for a dark isometric gothic action game. Primary request: one square texture only, looking vertically down at still deep reservoir water, dark charcoal-grey with muted olive-slate undertones, densely textured fine natural ripples and slight irregular scum traces. Very sparse faint warm amber broken reflection flecks from distant lanterns, no visible lanterns. Very low contrast, severe and atmospheric but readable as water, not stone. Uniform scale and illumination across the entire tile, seamless tileable on all four edges, no vignette, no edge frame, no shore, no perspective, no horizon, no objects, no text. Surface should be physically water, softly specular and finely rippled, not flat solid shapes, not blue, not cyan, not bright or glowing, not a portal. Produce a square full-bleed 1024x1024 opaque texture.
prompts.shelf: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent isometric game prop, a single freestanding record shelf for a severe gothic human-built Imperial service archive. Primary request: one narrow tall heavy cabinet with two upright dark weathered iron ribs, severe pointed upper profile, dark charcoal stone plinth and three open shelves holding dusty aged leather record books and plain tied parchment bundles. Object about 1.35 times human height, intended 120px high beside an88px knight. Dense tactile worn slate, pitted blackened iron, cracked leather and dust, realistic painterly sprite style, no cartoon and no flat shapes. Camera: orthographic three-quarter isometric, ground axes slope ±26.565 degrees (screen projection x=.8(worldX-worldY), y=.4(worldX+worldY)); see top, front and right side, verticals remain vertical. Shelf front faces viewer/screen lower left, right side recedes up-right. Cool soft upper-left light, warm brown records as tiny restrained accents, no glowing elements. Complete full object comfortably inside frame, transparent background and clean genuine alpha, no floor plane, no cast drop shadow, no vignettes, no ground scenery. Base is broad and weighted, book volumes readable at small scale but no legible invented text, no letters or symbols, no skulls, no people, no candles, no ornaments beyond austere narrow gothic ribbing. Single object only.
prompts.lever: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent separated-mechanism sprite source for a small isometric game lever. Primary request: TWO ISOLATED PARTS in a single wide sheet, lots of transparent space between them: LEFT a freestanding severe dark-stone and blackened-iron lever pedestal with a small visible circular steel pivot socket on its front upper face and absolutely NO shaft or handle attached; RIGHT a separate straight narrow steel shaft with a short horizontal aged brass T grip at the top and a circular pivot eye at its bottom. This is one mundane mechanical lever, NOT magical technology. LEFT BASE proportion: total height 26 game pixels, broad foot width23 pixels and depth12 pixels in projection; narrower upright body width14 pixels and height22 pixels. The pivot centre sits20 pixels vertically above the ground-contact centre. Make it compact, not a tall column, the socket flush on the FRONT face directly over the foot centre. RIGHT HANDLE proportion: straight shaft length24 game pixels from lower pivot centre to upper brass grip midpoint, grip span10 pixels and thickness3 pixels, shaft thickness3 pixels; separate part shown vertical upright, no diagonal perspective angle, no base below it. Rich physical surface texture, worn edges and rivets, grounded practical industrial medieval mechanism, no ornate nonsense. Base camera orthographic isometric with ground-axis slopes ±26.565 degrees, verticals vertical; upper-left cool diffuse light, same dark slate charcoal realistic painterly game art style. One base and one handle ONLY, no text, no labels, no grid, no diagram arrows, no floor, no cast shadow, no extra objects, clean actual transparent alpha everywhere around and between parts. Complete full parts uncropped with generous transparent margins.
prompts.leverBodyRefinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied transparent two-part lever sprite source. Output only the LEFT stone-and-iron pedestal, remove the RIGHT separated handle entirely (it is already retained separately). Refine the pedestal to fit the existing game mechanism exactly, without changing material/style/light/ground camera. The visible pivot socket centre MUST be vertically above the centre of the diamond footprint, not offset toward the left side. Extend the narrower vertical body upward so the pivot socket is much higher: pivot height20px above the centre of the footprint when footprint width is23px and projected depth12px. Overall height about29px. Keep the socket centre about4px below the top of the narrow body. Make the FRONT face nearly frontal and balanced enough that the pivot reads centred above the plinth; do not change the isometric foot shape. Pedestal should look like a compact rectangular iron-bound dark stone block, not a tapering tower, not ornate. No shaft, no handle, no extra detached rings. Preserve actual genuine alpha, complete object, no background, no ground plane, no cast shadow. Keep dark tactile stone and pitted steel details, not flat geometric fills.
prompts.leverSocketRefinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Single tiny geometric correction to this transparent lever pedestal sprite. Keep exactly the whole object's stone/metal silhouette, height, width, footprint, isometric perspective, lighting, textures and transparent alpha unchanged. MOVE ONLY the circular socket on the upper front face about85 pixels to the RIGHT (roughly one half of its outer radius), keeping its y coordinate unchanged. The dark hole centre should end up on the vertical line directly over the diamond plinth's centre. Fill the former socket location with the same continuous textured iron surface. Do not add any holes or rivets there. Do not change or regenerate anything else. Same complete object no crop, no background, no shaft, no handle.
